name: Handwritten
description: Ink on warm paper, in a hand-drawn face.
bestFor: Notes, journals, and invites that should feel written, not set.

tokens.font: 'Segoe Script', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Bradley Hand', cursive

promptFragment: Visual style: Handwritten. Use warm paper, ink-blue text, a coral action, and a cursive or printed-hand family. The frame is a solid stroke with a soft radius, and there is no glossy shadow. Avoid monospace, an all-caps grotesque, neon, and a perfect technical grid. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
